export function braced(kind: string): number {
  switch (kind) {
    case 'a': {
      const value = 1;
      return value;
    }
    case 'b': {
      return 2;
    }
    default: {
      return 0;
    }
  }
}

export function unbraced(kind: string): number {
  let result = 0;
  switch (kind) {
    case 'a':
    case 'b':
      result = 1;
      break;
    case 'c':
      result = 2;
      break;
    default:
      result = 3;
  }
  return result;
}
